thread:
aditya: Vendor just sent an embargoed advisory about an HSM attestation regression impacting BYOK signing (CVE-2026-XY12). Need quick triage: RBAC, logs, KMS fallback. Who can take?
zoe: Noted. Is there a repro? can you DM it?
aditya: Sent DM with repro steps. Customer reported attestation mismatch after firmware patch.
felix: Immediate mitigations: disable auto-firmware on affected clusters, bump audit level for kex/wrap events, snapshot attestation blobs, prepare rewrap plan to vetted HSM pool.
zoe: I'll run a quick IAM+audit sweep for principals with WrapKey+ExportKey. Quick log query I'll use:
```
resource.type="hsm_key" protoPayload.methodName="WrapKey"
```
ops-bot: ALERT: unusual wrap attempts detected on hsm-prod-us-west. Incident logged #6161112230 :rotating_light:
security-bot: Reminder: follow BYOK incident runbook and notify Compliance if keys protect regulated data.
aditya: Assignments: @zoe run principal scan & collect wrap logs; @felix start RBAC PR to remove ExportKey where WrapKey exists and enable JIT for hsm-admin; I'll contact vendor and draft a short customer note.
zoe: Scan complete, DM'd results to aditya. Found 1 principal with both perms in prod-us-west. Logs uploaded to secure vault.
aditya: Good. If attestation chain fails we'll offer rewrap and forensic package to affected BYOK customers. Keep updates here.
